_readme: Perch & Plume music cues, wave 1. Each cue has 2 versions (a and b). Save as games/perch-and-plume/music/<cue>-a.mp3 and <cue>-b.mp3; the build registers only files that exist, so no code change is needed. Slots: menu, main, fight loop; victory, defeat play once.

menu.prompt: Instrumental game music, no vocals, no spoken words, acoustic and gentle, mixed for a phone game. Slow 72 BPM pastoral title theme: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft flute and light birdsong-like woodwind trills, morning calm, 4-bar intro then 16-bar sections, ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly. Make 2 versions (a and b).

main.prompt: Instrumental game music, no vocals, no spoken words, acoustic and gentle, mixed for a phone game. Unhurried 90 BPM board-game loop: plucked strings, marimba, a light hand drum, curious and cosy like a naturalist sketching in a meadow, steady and unobtrusive, loops cleanly. Make 2 versions (a and b).

fight.prompt: Instrumental game music, no vocals, no spoken words, acoustic and gentle, mixed for a phone game. 100 BPM boss-chapter loop: the same pastoral palette with a tense low cello ostinato and brisk pizzicato, a friendly rivalry, loops cleanly. Make 2 versions (a and b).

victory.prompt: Instrumental game music, no vocals, no spoken words, acoustic and gentle, mixed for a phone game. Short bright fanfare: flute and strings rising, a joyful birdsong flourish, ends warmly. Make 2 versions (a and b).

defeat.prompt: Instrumental game music, no vocals, no spoken words, acoustic and gentle, mixed for a phone game. Short gentle sigh: soft solo clarinet descending over warm strings, kind not sad, ends quietly. Make 2 versions (a and b).
